paper.title_en: Quantum Black Hole Chemistry from Double Holography
paper.abstract_en: Extended black hole thermodynamics highlights a sharp tension in the usual holographic dictionary: at fixed boundary conformal frame, changing the AdS radius changes both the central charge and the spatial volume of the CFT, so that the color and volume sectors of the first law becomes degenerate. We show that this degeneracy is naturally removed for quantum black holes in Karch--Randall double holography. The mechanism is intrinsically semiclassical. Replacing the holographic regulator surface by a physical brane induces gravity coupled to a cutoff CFT, so classical bulk black holes become lower-dimensional quantum black holes whose geometry includes the cutoff-matter stress tensor to all orders in backreaction. This backreacting matter sector supplies a color variable distinct from the defect volume. We demonstrate the mechanism explicitly for the quantum BTZ black hole. Thus quantum backreaction resolves the same color-volume degeneracy addressed by the recent Weyl-factor proposal, but without introducing a non-standard boundary Weyl factor. Instead, the missing thermodynamic direction is supplied by the physical cutoff-matter sector of the doubly holographic quantum black hole.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文属于扩展黑洞热力学（黑洞化学）方向，直面AdS/CFT字典中固定边界共形框架下色荷与体积自由度简并的紧张关系，提出在Karch-Randall双全息框架中用半经典量子反作用自然解除简并，并显式演示于量子BTZ黑洞，理论深度高、问题定位清晰，且与近期Weyl因子方案形成直接对话，值得深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 双全息中的量子黑洞化学
decision.abstract_zh: 扩展黑洞热力学凸显了通常全息字典中的一个尖锐张力：在固定的边界共形框架下，改变AdS半径会同时改变中心荷与CFT的空间体积，从而使第一定律中的色荷扇区与体积扇区出现简并。我们证明，在Karch--Randall双全息中，对于量子黑洞，这种简并被自然地消除。该机制本质上是半经典的。将全息正则化面替换为物理膜后，诱导出与截断CFT耦合的引力，于是经典体黑洞变为低维量子黑洞，其几何结构在所有反作用阶数上包含截断物质的应力张量。这一反作用物质扇区提供了一个不同于缺陷体积的色荷变量。我们针对量子BTZ黑洞显式演示了该机制。因此，量子反作用解决了近期Weyl因子方案所处理的同一色荷-体积简并问题，但无需引入非标准的边界Weyl因子。相反，缺失的热力学方向由双全息量子黑洞的物理截断物质扇区提供。
